name: Oyama (Shizuoka, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Oyama town emblem in white: an outlined ring with a small point at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Oyama, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 December 1969.

features.role: Oyama town emblem — an outlined ring with a small point at the top
